title: Migrate
description: Review everything on your old platform before anything is created, import only what you pick, then walk each app through cutover.

connect.title: Read the source
connect.description: Read-only. Nothing is created until you pick items and import. The token is used for this page only and never stored.
connect.insecure: Skip TLS verification of the source

item.previewApp: {{name}}, image {{image}}, port {{port}}, {{env}} env vars, {{secrets}} secrets, {{volumes}} volumes
item.unselectable: This item cannot be imported here

fix.title: Fix
fix.holdDomainsHint: Already routed to another app here: {{domains}}

import.doneHint: Imported apps now have a cutover checklist.
import.noneSelected: Select at least one item first.

empty.title: Nothing read yet
empty.description: Connect to your old platform above to see every app, database and service with a verdict for each.

cutover.emptyHint: Apps imported from another platform get a checklist here.
cutover.blocked: This step cannot be completed yet

stepHelp.data_verified: Database row counts and volume file counts and sizes match the source.
stepHelp.shadow_running: The app is healthy here while the old one still serves traffic.
stepHelp.dns_switched: Every domain resolves here, has a certificate and answers its health path.
stepHelp.old_stopped: You stopped the old instance. The control plane cannot see it, so you confirm it.

verify.databasesHint: Comma separated names of databases copied for this app. Each needs a verified data copy.
verify.volumesHint: Run the source command on the old host and the target command on this node, then enter the two results.

agent.safetyTitle: Read only, but it sees everything Docker sees
agent.safety: The agent only lists what runs on the old server and counts files and bytes in volumes. It cannot start, stop, change or run anything there, and it does not move data in this release. Docker access is root on that host, so install it only on a server you are leaving, and remove it when you are done.
agent.startHint: Creates a token that works once and expires soon. Run the command it gives you on the old server as root.
agent.label: Name for this server
agent.installTitle: Run this on the old server
agent.installHint: Shown once. The token works once, and the session ends on its own after {{hours}} hours.
agent.noAddress: No agent address is advertised on this control plane. Set the advertise host, then create the command again.
agent.emptyHint: Create an install command above to inspect the old server before cutover.
agent.waiting: Waiting for the agent to connect. The token is single use and expires soon after it was created.
agent.unlisted: Not matched to an imported app
agent.unlistedHint: {{count}} container(s) match no imported app, so a platform API read would not have shown them.
agent.removeConsequence1: The session and its certificate are revoked now, even if the old server is unreachable.
agent.removeConsequence2: On the old server, run the remove command of the migrate binary to delete its service, identity and binary.
agent.verifyHint: Counts files and bytes of each volume on the old server and compares them with this server. Zero differences complete the data step for you, unless a volume is empty or you typed target numbers by hand.
agent.ackEmpty: Some volumes are meant to be empty: let matching empty volumes count as verified
agent.detailForbidden: Your role cannot view the discovered containers and paths for this session.
agent.noVolumes: No imported app has volumes to compare.
agent.compare: source {{sf}} files {{sb}} bytes, here {{tf}} files {{tb}} bytes
agent.advancedHint: Every volume matched, so the migration agent marked the data step done. You can undo it.
agent.databasesManualHint: {{count}} database(s) on the old server are not checked by the agent. Copy and verify them before you cut over.
